title: Acts
author: Luke, as the second volume to the Gospel of Luke.
historicalSetting: Acts records the risen Christ working by the Holy Spirit through His witnesses from Jerusalem to Rome.
keyVerse: Acts 1:8 — "You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you."
christFocus: Acts points to Christ as the risen and exalted Lord who pours out the Holy Spirit and sends His witnesses to the ends of the earth.
